cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Gracious Command
cards.instruction: Remain warm and appreciative while steadily reducing everyone else’s room to choose.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll decide how we handle this. Thank you for finding reunion venues. My garden will make everyone feel at home.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The hall has shelter if it rains.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You can question the details after my decision. Such thoughtful planning. I'll put a gazebo in the garden.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll keep the hall reservation as a backup.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're a lifesaver. Cancel it and put the deposit toward my gazebo; then we're all committed.

mechanism: A warmly approves only solutions inside A chosen garden plan, reducing B venue options while behaving as final arbiter.
confusable: D53 delegates unwanted work by rank; D69 specifically keeps appreciation warm while the choices narrow.
comparison: A venue backup being surrendered differs from a moving helper losing choice of both object and task division.
seedUse: Use D69-a rain and gazebo solution; remove cold prefixed reprimand and establish any refunded deposit rather than assume it.
